name: 龔宇睿
objective:
介紹高分子分子結構、型態學、流變學、化學性質、熱性質、機械、電學及光學等特性之分析方法及實例。
This course will cover the examples of analysis of the mechanical, thermal, electrical, optical and chemical properties, and the structure, morphology, and rheology of polymers.
schedule:
Weeks 1-2: Gel Permeation Chromatography, GPC
Weeks 3-4: Differential Scanning Calorimetry, DSC
Week 5: Thermogravimetric Analysis,TGA
Weeks 6-7: Dynamic Mechanical Analysis, DMA
Week 8: Rheometer
Week 9: Mid-Exam
Weeks 10-17: 實例分析 Analysis Examples
Week 18: Final-Exam
scorePolicy:
Attendance: 10%
Homework: 20%
Mid-exam: 30%
Final-exam: 40%
Extra bouns: 1~5%
materials:
Polymer Chemistry, An introduction, 3rd. Ed. Malcolm P. Stevens, ISBN :	9780195392098
Polymers: Chemistry and Physics of Modern Materials, 2nd Ed.,
J. M. G. Cowie,.
